title: How Agentic DevOps gave us Dev time back

segments.text: Okay, perfect. Let us start. Thanks for joining the session. So, in this session I'm going to talk about two things. On one side, time, and on the
other time on the other side, agents. So, basically, time is all, and the more time you save, basically, in daily task and routines, the more time you have to dedicate to
other things and be more proactive. So, basically, I'm Alex, and the CPO and co-founder of Resices. So, we are dedicated to cloud infrastructure and to
platform engineering. I'm going to start with a story about the time that when I went to San Francisco, I met a guy that told me at
that moment we were developing a developer product. And our core was platform engineering. So, he told us that why we are centering our focus in
something that is not related with infrastructure lately. So, from that moment, I passed the message to the team, I I myself thought about it. So,
at that moment we pivot, and we figured out that we were 1 year late on the actual concept of being more focused and dedicated to platform.
So basically during that year and working really close with clients, we understand the pain of the on-boarding to the clients, also the many others that we were
receiving, and some of them we dedicate time that it doesn't matter that much. And also the contest within the team, several people working on the team from
different backgrounds, but we didn't have the the same contact context at all. And lastly, the different tools that we use is not a place that where
everything is unified, so you can spend time switching or jumping between the tools, right? So, our solutions came up and it's an infrastructure agent. So, basically it's called Agentyk
and it can connect with your infrastructure and gives you information about topics like cost. So, how you are spending your money and how you can
manage and improve the the potential cost savings. Also, things related with observability and the different metrics that you need to have in consideration to manage the infrastructure. And also,
now at this moment the contest is unify in one place and all the team can have the information at a hand. Also, we focus the the agent on a
multi-cloud environment so you can have in the same application the information of different cloud providers as AWS, GCP, or Azure. It's also capable of
making PR drafts based on the needs that or optimizations that you need to do. And then a human can in the loop can review what the agent is proposing. And
also, it's suggest different insights to improve and potential your infrastructure as well as automations with different other tools and mechanisms. Uh, so a final reflection is
that the time doesn't come back but at the end what we learn with this path is that now the team is sync. We have
everything together and using an agent for for daily task. Also, we reduce the time on making task that was taking up more time that is supposed to.
Uh, also we have a better support for our clients because we have a source of truth and and all the team can benefit from that. And finally,
we have or decrease the burnout on the people from the team using this approach. So, that's the story. Uh, We will release the agent soon.
Thanks for for staying.
